purpose: Test whether DS4 MXFP4 gate stream failure was caused by using the non-ids single-column MMVQ path instead of the dedicated MoE ids kernel.
code_changes: For experimental DS4 MXFP4/F8 stream, compact cne1 rows are quantized together and routed through the existing MoE ids kernel with all ids set to zero for the current expert.
conclusion: The DS4 MXFP4 gate stream failure is not explained by the non-ids MMVQ path; a small CPU-vs-GPU numeric diff harness is required before further full-model stream trials.
next_steps: Capture one MXFP4 expert and one activation row, then compare CPU vec_dot_mxfp4_q8_0 output against CUDA MXFP4 output for the same rows.
Localize mismatch to weight layout, activation quantization, output layout, or CUDA vec-dot.
